objective: Sincronizador: auditar en solo lectura por qué Reportes ISCAM indica 1 día sin sincronizar para CIENFUEGOS en octubre 2026. Comparar por día la fuente canónica Runtime V2 contra Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto exactamente con el contrato _detail_coverage de iscam_routes.py. Identificar fecha faltante o desajustada y deltas de venta/tickets/PAX. No modificar datos ni Producción.

queries.name: iscam_octubre_cienfuegos_runtime_vs_detalle
queries.sql:
WITH runtime AS (
          SELECT CAST(fecha_operacion AS date) AS fecha_operacion,
                 SUM(CAST(ISNULL(ventas_total,0) AS decimal(18,4))) AS ventas_runtime,
                 SUM(CAST(ISNULL(tickets_total,0) AS bigint)) AS tickets_runtime,
                 SUM(CAST(ISNULL(pax_total,0) AS bigint)) AS pax_runtime
          FROM dbo.vw_Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2_Runtime
          WHERE unidad_negocio_id='CIENFUEGOS'
            AND fecha_operacion>='2026-10-01' AND fecha_operacion<'2026-10-14'
            AND (ISNULL(ventas_total,0)<>0 OR ISNULL(tickets_total,0)<>0 OR ISNULL(pax_total,0)<>0)
          GROUP BY CAST(fecha_operacion AS date)
        ),
        detalle_ticket AS (
          SELECT CAST(fecha_operacion AS date) AS fecha_operacion,
                 numero_ticket,
                 SUM(CAST(ISNULL(importe_neto,0) AS decimal(18,4))) AS ventas_ticket,
                 MAX(CAST(ISNULL(pax,0) AS bigint)) AS pax_ticket
          FROM dbo.Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto
          WHERE unidad_negocio_id='CIENFUEGOS'
            AND fecha_operacion>='2026-10-01' AND fecha_operacion<'2026-10-14'
            AND ISNULL(activo,1)=1 AND ISNULL(es_kpi_valido,1)=1
          GROUP BY CAST(fecha_operacion AS date),numero_ticket
        ),
        detalle AS (
          SELECT fecha_operacion,
                 SUM(ventas_ticket) AS ventas_detalle,
                 COUNT(*) AS tickets_detalle,
                 SUM(pax_ticket) AS pax_detalle
          FROM detalle_ticket
          GROUP BY fecha_operacion
        )
        SELECT r.fecha_operacion,
               r.ventas_runtime,r.tickets_runtime,r.pax_runtime,
               d.ventas_detalle,d.tickets_detalle,d.pax_detalle,
               CAST(r.ventas_runtime-ISNULL(d.ventas_detalle,0) AS decimal(18,2)) AS delta_venta,
               r.tickets_runtime-ISNULL(d.tickets_detalle,0) AS delta_tickets,
               r.pax_runtime-ISNULL(d.pax_detalle,0) AS delta_pax,
               CASE
                 WHEN d.fecha_operacion IS NULL THEN 'MISSING_DETAIL'
                 WHEN ABS(r.ventas_runtime-d.ventas_detalle)>0.05
                   OR r.tickets_runtime<>d.tickets_detalle
                   OR r.pax_runtime<>d.pax_detalle THEN 'MISMATCH'
                 ELSE 'OK'
               END AS estado
        FROM runtime r
        LEFT JOIN detalle d ON d.fecha_operacion=r.fecha_operacion
        ORDER BY r.fecha_operacion

queries.name: iscam_octubre_cienfuegos_problem_dates
queries.sql:
WITH runtime AS (
          SELECT CAST(fecha_operacion AS date) AS fecha_operacion,
                 SUM(CAST(ISNULL(ventas_total,0) AS decimal(18,4))) AS ventas_runtime,
                 SUM(CAST(ISNULL(tickets_total,0) AS bigint)) AS tickets_runtime,
                 SUM(CAST(ISNULL(pax_total,0) AS bigint)) AS pax_runtime
          FROM dbo.vw_Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2_Runtime
          WHERE unidad_negocio_id='CIENFUEGOS'
            AND fecha_operacion>='2026-10-01' AND fecha_operacion<'2026-10-14'
            AND (ISNULL(ventas_total,0)<>0 OR ISNULL(tickets_total,0)<>0 OR ISNULL(pax_total,0)<>0)
          GROUP BY CAST(fecha_operacion AS date)
        ),
        detalle_ticket AS (
          SELECT CAST(fecha_operacion AS date) AS fecha_operacion,
                 numero_ticket,
                 SUM(CAST(ISNULL(importe_neto,0) AS decimal(18,4))) AS ventas_ticket,
                 MAX(CAST(ISNULL(pax,0) AS bigint)) AS pax_ticket
          FROM dbo.Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto
          WHERE unidad_negocio_id='CIENFUEGOS'
            AND fecha_operacion>='2026-10-01' AND fecha_operacion<'2026-10-14'
            AND ISNULL(activo,1)=1 AND ISNULL(es_kpi_valido,1)=1
          GROUP BY CAST(fecha_operacion AS date),numero_ticket
        ),
        detalle AS (
          SELECT fecha_operacion,SUM(ventas_ticket) AS ventas_detalle,COUNT(*) AS tickets_detalle,SUM(pax_ticket) AS pax_detalle
          FROM detalle_ticket GROUP BY fecha_operacion
        )
        SELECT r.fecha_operacion,r.ventas_runtime,ISNULL(d.ventas_detalle,0) AS ventas_detalle,
               r.tickets_runtime,ISNULL(d.tickets_detalle,0) AS tickets_detalle,
               r.pax_runtime,ISNULL(d.pax_detalle,0) AS pax_detalle
        FROM runtime r
        LEFT JOIN detalle d ON d.fecha_operacion=r.fecha_operacion
        WHERE d.fecha_operacion IS NULL
           OR ABS(r.ventas_runtime-ISNULL(d.ventas_detalle,0))>0.05
           OR r.tickets_runtime<>ISNULL(d.tickets_detalle,0)
           OR r.pax_runtime<>ISNULL(d.pax_detalle,0)
        ORDER BY r.fecha_operacion
